Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif's Message on the International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking 26 June, 2026. On the International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking, Pakistan joins the international community in reaffirming its collective resolve to take all possible measures to combat this grave social challenge. This day serves as a reminder of the multidimensional human, economic, and social costs of drug abuse and trafficking, as well as their devastating consequences for societies worldwide. This year’s theme, “World drug problem: Persisting Issues, New Challenges, Innovative responses" draws attention to the grave and evolving nature of the global drug problem. Pakistan remains steadfast and fully committed to addressing all threats associated with narcotic drugs, including the emergence of new substances, illicit trafficking networks, and the accessibility of drugs, especially to our youth. The Government continues to strengthen national capacities, enhance institutional coordination, and expand cooperation with international partners to eliminate drug trafficking. Only through the complete dismantling of illicit networks can we ensure a safer and more secure society. Protecting our younger generation from the scourge of drugs remains a national priority. Ensuring drug-free educational institutions is among the most important steps toward safeguarding future generations. Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF) is undertaking effective measures to prevent drug trafficking, reduce drug demand, raise public awareness, and facilitate the treatment and rehabilitation of affected individuals. Government’s simultaneous focus on law enforcement, prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation reflects a balanced and comprehensive strategy to address the drug menace. On this occasion, I pay a special tribute to the brave martyrs of the Anti-Narcotics Force who laid down their lives in service of the nation. Their courage, sacrifice, and unwavering sense of duty remain a source of immense pride for all of us. Furthermore, the Government of Pakistan is enhancing the capacities of all relevant institutions engaged in counter-narcotics efforts. In collaboration with provincial governments, awareness and prevention programmes in educational institutions are being expanded, while treatment and rehabilitation facilities are being further strengthened. Pakistan is also deepening international partnerships through intelligence sharing, joint operations, and effective regional cooperation to counter illicit trafficking networks. I call upon parents, teachers, educational institutions, community leaders, the media, and our youth to play their vital role in the fight against drugs. Raising awareness, promoting prevention, and fostering a healthy and resilient society are our shared national responsibility.

On the day of Ashura, we reflect on the enduring values of courage, sacrifice, compassion, and steadfastness in the face of adversity. This day reminds us that righteousness is always worth the sacrifice. And as we reflect on this solemn occasion, we reaffirm our commitment to a more just and humane world for all.

Ashura is a time of remembrance, sacrifice and reflection. Today, on the 10th day of Muharram, we are reminded of Imam Hussain's unwavering commitment to truth and dignity. His timeless legacy reminds us of the enduring values of faith, service to one another, and the belief that justice is always worth fighting for. Our City’s strength comes from the many faith traditions that shape it — and our shared struggle against injustice and oppression. May we carry these values forward as we continue building a more just City for every New Yorker.

Em Ponta Porã (MS), anunciamos nesta tarde uma série de ações para fortalecer a agricultura familiar e avançar com a reforma agrária. 1️⃣ Entregamos 1.390 títulos de propriedade para famílias assentadas em uma região que produz grãos, frutas, leite, hortaliças e trabalha a criação de pequenos animais. O documento definitivo da terra significa tranquilidade para investir, produzir mais e acessar linhas de crédito. 2️⃣ Anunciamos R$ 20 milhões para modernizar cooperativas, melhorar o armazenamento de grãos, reduzir perdas e impulsionar o desenvolvimento sustentável. 3️⃣ Assinamos novos contratos do Programa de Aquisição de Alimentos, que permite comprar direto dos pequenos produtores alimentos orgânicos e saudáveis para usar na merenda escolar, em cozinhas solidárias, hospitais públicos e projetos sociais. 4️⃣ Mais de R$ 8 milhões foram liberados em crédito para melhoria de moradias e apoio aos assentados. 5️⃣ Acordo que transforma grandes dívidas de impostos de empresas com a União em terras para reforma agrária. São mais de 72 mil hectares (área equivalente a 100 mil campos de futebol) destinados para assentar mais de 5,7 mil famílias. Garantir terra, crédito e estrutura para a agricultura familiar é gerar renda no campo e comida barata e de qualidade na cidade. Cuidar de quem coloca o alimento na mesa do povo brasileiro é prioridade do Governo do Brasil. 📸 @ricardostuckert

Hadron, the recently IPO'd micro reactor version of NuScale is not ok. "Hadron Energy, with its young founder, seasoned advisors, and ambitious SPAC trajectory, embodies many of the hopes currently being projected onto the American nuclear startup sector. It is perhaps the clearest example yet of how the United States is trying to innovate its way around the absence of a functioning nuclear industrial base. The notion that a startup can mobilize capital, licensing expertise, fabrication capacity, and a stable vendor ecosystem at a pace that outstrips state-directed industrial programs like the RITM-200 driven efforts to open Russia’s arctic is not supported by historical or contemporary evidence. None of this is a critique of Hadron’s sincerity or effort. Rather, it is an indictment of the “post industrial” environment in which the company operates. A young founder in the USA may believe that nuclear success is a matter of personal drive, when the real bottlenecks are the decadal loss of nuclear megaproject management skills, construction productivity, ASME N stamped fabrication, NQA 1 supply chain and heavy forging availability. The broader narrative of nuclear as a startup frontier, is therefore less a reflection of genuine opportunity than of a country that has let core industrial capabilities atrophy and now tries to outsource state capacity to private ambition." Today’s earthquake in #Venezuela is a painful reminder that no country is immune to seismic risk, and that preparedness saves lives. This is why, in collaboration with the Government of Türkiye 🇹🇷, we are convening the @WHO Ministerial Conference on Advancing Health Security through Earthquake Emergency Management in Istanbul on 1 and 2 July. The strong engagement in this conference reflects the urgency of the issue: 27 Member States from 4 WHO regions, including 8 ministers and senior health leaders, as well as UN partners, emergency responders and civil society organizations. Earthquakes are the deadliest natural hazard on Earth, accounting for more than 50% of all deaths from natural-hazard disasters between 2000 and 2023. But we can reduce the consequences by acting before disaster strikes – making hospitals ready to operate under pressure, keeping essential health services running, testing emergency response plans, training health workers, and preparing emergency medical teams to deploy quickly and provide immediate care. Over 2 days in Istanbul, we will share lessons, strengthen collaboration and advance practical action to better protect lives and health before, during and after earthquakes. 🇯🇵🇺🇸 | Anduril rachète l’usine Nissan pour produire des drones de guerre au Japon L’entreprise américaine de défense Anduril Industries est en discussions pour acquérir l’usine Oppama de Nissan, près de Tokyo, afin d’y produire des drones militaires au Japon, alors que le pays accélère le développement de son industrie de défense dans un contexte de préoccupations croissantes concernant une éventuelle crise dans le détroit de Taïwan. 📝 Le choix du site est stratégique : Oppama jouxte la base navale de Yokosuka, QG de la Force maritime japonaise et point d’ancrage du seul groupe aéronaval avancé de l’US Navy en Indo-Pacifique. Implanter une ligne de production de drones à cet endroit revient à fusionner capacité industrielle et posture opérationnelle, en cas de montée en tension dans le Détroit de Taïwan, les stocks sont déjà prépositionnés dans le théâtre. Sur le plan doctrinal, la manœuvre répond à une vulnérabilité identifiée : le risque d’épuisement rapide des munitions en cas de conflit régional pousse Tokyo à densifier sa base industrielle de défense. En laissant Anduril porter l’investissement, le Japon accélère sa montée en capacité sans en assumer politiquement la charge, Washington finance, la production reste sur sol japonais. Un montage qui permet de contourner les résistances internes au réarmement tout en s’inscrivant pleinement dans la doctrine américaine de production décentralisée au plus près du front.

A 40-year-old woman was fined after emptying and stealing a Knicks-themed trash can off the streets of New York City on Thursday, June 18, during the team’s championship parade, according to local news reports. Vincent Gragnani, a spokesman for the New York City Department of Sanitation, told The New York Times that Angie Baez returned the orange-and-blue container on the morning of Wednesday, June 24, and was fined $175 for littering and “impeding” sanitation operations. Footage filmed by Ajael James-Evans shows Baez dumping trash out of the wastebasket and walking away with it. “Although I don’t condone littering or stealing, in the moment, it felt like all the other crazy stuff that the Knicks fans were doing,” James-Evans told Storyful. “Every where you looked, there was someone doing something a little crazy that was social-media-post-worthy, due to the excitement of the day. The New York Police Department said it was not investigating the incident, the Times reported. Video

I took a look at this. It's a good outcome, but let me fill you in on a few facts so you understand how crazy it is that we had to litigate this at all. In 2016, there was such a huge surge of migrants on the border that DHS couldn't possibly process them all. So it set limits, and would allow a small number into the US each day to be processed, and those people could then start the process of requesting asylum. The people standing at the border who couldn't get processed right away then filed a class action lawsuit, claiming their "rights" were violated. The District Court agreed with them, and the Ninth Circuit affirmed. So our courts ruled that migrants - people who are not citizens of the United States - can use American law to sue the American government basically to let them in. That's a little simplified but more or less the case. The statutory issue is when a migrant can be considered to have "arrived in the US." The lower courts held that a migrant has "arrived" the moment he reaches the border and has any contact with US border patrol. So when an agent STOPS someone from entering, the District Court and the Ninth Circuit ruled that the migrant had in fact "arrived" in the USA, such that he can take advantage of our laws and sue our government. That is the madness that SCOTUS put a stop to today. Keep in mind also that this lawsuit has been going on since 2017. So for nearly 10 years, we have wasted resources to get a SCOTUS ruling that is just basic common sense. I never expected we would see this. Always assumed it would stop before now. Russia is soon going to learn the lesson Germany did in WWII. In WWII, the allied bombing campaign greatly reduced German fuel production. Germany continued to expand military production, and overall they did. However, German industry was not able to move components from factory to factory. Final assembly and shipment to the front ground to a hault. As fuel shortages expand and rationing extends, Russian industry will slowly and then quickly feel the strain. Shipments will get more expensive and delayed. Then when Ukraine strikes factories, repair parts will be delayed. The ability flex will decline. At some point, the system crashes when heavy machinery fails and replacements don't happen. I won't predict when, but as the strikes continue, it looks closer and closer. Malcontent News (@MalcontentmentT) Russian fuel shortages continue to expand. Only 3 Russian regions have no issues with fuel supplies. Oman's plan for the Strait of Hormuz may not be the same as that of Iran, but it would represent a change from status quo and requires consultation. Currently Oman is working with the UN International Maritime Office for an orderly phased evacuation of tankers, but medium term Oman more interested in the Malacca and SIngapore Straits mechanism where countries or ships can contribute for services under Article 43 of UNCLOS the law of the sea. The Article provides that user States and States bordering a strait should by agreement cooperate with respect to navigational safety and environmental protection. It is a very pragmatic model, and the services provided in a very busy waterway are environmental and safety related, but not security linked. Nor is it a compulsory toll, or intended as a cash cow. Oman's thinking is quite advanced, both legally and practically, and is now started to be shared. One Idea is for Oman to set up this model and let Iran join later, or to see if they can work together. Iran has passed UNCLOS, but not ratified the Treaty. Many Iranian lawyers recognise a fully fledged toll will be challenged, and would not secure Oman support. PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

Investir em produção de fertilizantes é investir na soberania alimentar do Brasil. A retomada das obras da Unidade de Fertilizantes Nitrogenados III, em Três Lagoas (MS), fortalece nosso agronegócio e a agricultura familiar, e reduz a dependência brasileira por fertilizantes importados. PRODUÇÃO – A fábrica deve iniciar a operação comercial em 2029, e vai ter capacidade para produzir cerca de 1,3 milhão de toneladas de ureia por ano. Volume equivalente a aproximadamente 16% da demanda nacional. EMPREGOS – As obras devem gerar aproximadamente 8 mil empregos diretos e indiretos, além de impulsionar a economia regional. Hospedagem, alimentação e serviços são alguns dos setores que serão fortalecidos. LOGÍSTICA – A fábrica tem localização estratégica. O Centro-Oeste responde por cerca de 40% da demanda brasileira de ureia, impulsionada principalmente pelas culturas de milho, cana-de-açúcar, algodão e pastagens. Além disso, a fábrica vai exportar também para os estados do Sul e Sudeste. O Brasil não pode ficar na mão do mercado mundial de fertilizantes. Não faz sentido termos a autossuficiência em petróleo, contarmos com uma gigante mundial do porte e da qualidade da Petrobras e, ainda assim, passarmos por dificuldades quando eclodem conflitos internacionais. Guerras que não são nossas. Por isso investimos em fábricas como esta, em Três Lagoas. Produzirmos nossos fertilizantes é questão de soberania! 📸 @ricardostuckert

On this day in 1975, the Emergency was imposed in India. The Emergency remains one of the darkest chapters in the history of Indian democracy. During that period, freedom of speech and expression was curtailed, attempts were made to control and undermine the judiciary, and the rights of millions of citizens were violated. The Emergency reminds us that when those in power become authoritarian, the lives of citizens, democratic institutions, and constitutional values come under serious threat. Therefore, this day is not only an occasion to remember the past, but also an opportunity to reaffirm our commitment to democracy, the Constitution, and the rights and freedoms of citizens. Our government, under the leadership of Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, remains firmly committed to upholding the Constitution in both letter and spirit and to strengthening India’s democratic institutions. The nation remains indebted to all those who stood against the injustices and excesses of the Emergency and courageously defended democracy and the Constitution.

Today’s earthquake in Venezuela is a painful reminder that no country is immune to seismic risk, and that preparedness saves lives. This is why, in collaboration with the Government of Türkiye 🇹🇷, we are convening the @WHO Ministerial Conference on Advancing Health Security through Earthquake Emergency Management in Istanbul on 1 and 2 July. The strong engagement in this conference reflects the urgency of the issue: 27 Member States from 4 WHO regions, including 8 ministers and senior health leaders, as well as UN partners, emergency responders and civil society organizations. Earthquakes are the deadliest natural hazard on Earth, accounting for more than 50% of all deaths from natural-hazard disasters between 2000 and 2023. But we can reduce the consequences by acting before disaster strikes – making hospitals ready to operate under pressure, keeping essential health services running, testing emergency response plans, training health workers, and preparing emergency medical teams to deploy quickly and provide immediate care. Over 2 days in Istanbul, we will share lessons, strengthen collaboration and advance practical action to better protect lives and health before, during and after earthquakes. What exactly does SpaceX do? Quinn Slobodian: The SpaceX IPO prospectus lays it out quite clearly, and the way that they describe it is it has basically three segments, so there is a rocket segment, which is the Falcon 9 rockets, which have been doing a very good job at running many, many missions, often with the reusable rocket, the partially reusable rocketry that they pioneered about 10 years ago now. Then there is the connectivity segment, which is Starlink, and there are now around 10,000 of these low-Earth orbit satellites orbiting the Earth. In 2019 there were zero, so that's a fairly rapid upgrade. It's now about 70% of the satellites in orbit, and those provide relatively low latency broadband internet, and they're moving into direct-to-device mobile, too. So that's actually the only part of the company that currently makes money. The rockets more or less break even. Then there's the AI segment. And the AI segment is the most recent. xAI is a fairly new company. It is, at the moment, lagging quite far behind the front runners of Anthropic and OpenAI and even Google Gemini, but what people are buying, if you look at the prospectus and you look at the way SpaceX is being described by Musk, is the AI segment because most of the future growth, most of the future profit, 85% actually is supposed to come from the AI company selling its services.

Blue Ring MTO’s maneuverability and mass-delivery capability enable a new paradigm in exploration and scouting at Mars, filling current gaps and paving the way for human exploration. Blue Ring’s bi-propellant chemical propulsion enables standard transfer windows to Mars and timely insertion into an initial Martian orbit. The highly efficient electric propulsion system augments the chemical system by increasing performance and payload capacity during interplanetary cruise and provides maneuverability at Mars, enabling access to multiple scientifically interesting orbits in a single flight. Dave Limp (@davill) By providing both propulsion for delivery and Earth communications, Blue Ring MTO dramatically simplifies requirements for orbiters and landed assets at Mars, allowing them to focus on exploration, science, and scouting rather than basic infrastructure. Next-generation high-resolution imagery, weather and dust storm monitoring, and ice mapping for fuel resources and ice science are essential for enabling human landing and advancing Mars understanding. Blue Ring MTO’s infrastructure significantly reduces the complexity, cost, and risk of these missions, enabling swarms of lower-cost, smaller missions to perform next-generation science at Mars. NITI Aayog continues the nationwide rollout of NITI TARA (Toolkit for Analysis, Review & Action) through capacity-building sessions conducted today in Namchi (Sikkim), Nashik (Maharashtra), and Nuh (Haryana). NITI TARA, an “Experience in a Box” solution, is supporting States in strengthening evidence-based planning and governance by equipping district and block administrations with integrated data, analytics, and visualisation tools. The platform enables informed decision-making, effective monitoring, and targeted interventions to improve development outcomes. By strengthening local capacities for data-driven planning and governance, NITI TARA is helping transform data into action and strategy into impact, furthering the vision of responsive and evidence-based public service delivery. #NITITARA #DataDrivenGovernance @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

NITI Aayog, in collaboration with the Society of Community Health Oriented Operational Links (SCHOOL), organised a National Consultation on Human Resources for Elderly Care at India International Centre, New Delhi. The consultation brought together policymakers, representatives from health and skilling ministries, CSR leaders, and civil society experts to deliberate on the development of a dedicated cadre of ‘Caregivers for Elderly’ to strengthen India’s elder care ecosystem. The consultation featured a keynote address by Prof. (Dr.) M. Srinivas, Member, NITI Aayog, along with expert remarks by Prof. (Dr.) Vinod Paul, Former Member, NITI Aayog. Shri Rajib Kumar Sen, Programme Director, NITI Aayog, outlined the vision for a national framework on human resources for elderly care. The discussions focused on competency frameworks, certification pathways, financing mechanisms, and strategies for state-level adoption. The consultation generated key recommendations that will contribute to the development of a Concept Note and Position Paper for consideration. #ElderlyCare #HealthcareWorkforce @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiri

DRDO achieved a significant milestone with the successful accomplishment of Final Operational Clearance (FOC) for the Indigenous Netra Airborne Early Warning and Control (AEW&C) system, a major boost to the nation’s airborne surveillance and network-centric warfare capabilities. The ceremony was held today at CABS, DRDO, Bengaluru. Air Marshal Awadhesh Kumar Bharti, SYSM, AVSM, VM was the Chief Guest of the event. Former Chief of the Air Staff Air Chief Marshal RKS Bhadauria, PVSM, AVS,VM, ADC (Retd.) and Former Chairman of DRDO Dr. S Christopher was the Guests of Honour. During the event Dr B K Das, DG (ECS), Dr K Rajalakshmi Menon, DG (Aero), Director CABS and Chief Executive CEMILAC were also present. Over 200 officers from IAF and DRDO fraternity attended the event. Secretary DDR&D and Chairman DRDO congratulated DG Aero and "TEAM AEW&C" from DRDO, IAF, Airworthiness Agencies, Academia and Indian Industry partners for achieving this milestone

नागपूर मेट्रो टप्पा-2 चा विस्तार आणि मुंबईच्या सागरी सेतू-वांद्रे किल्ला कनेक्टरला मान्यता मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज विधानभवन, मुंबई येथे मंत्रिमंडळ पायाभूत सुविधा समितीची बैठक पार पडली. नागपूर मेट्रो रेल टप्पा 2 अंतर्गत कन्हान नदी ते कन्हान शहर या दरम्यान विस्तारीत उन्नत मेट्रो मार्गिका उभारण्यास तसेच मुंबईतील स्वातंत्र्यवीर सावरकर सागरी सेतू वांद्रे किल्ल्याशी जोडण्यासाठी कनेक्टर उभारण्यास मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज झालेल्या मंत्रिमंडळ पायाभूत सुविधा समितीच्या बैठकीत मान्यता देण्यात आली. स्वातंत्र्यवीर सावरकर सागरी सेतूपासून वांद्रे किल्ल्यापर्यंत अतिरिक्त जोडरस्ता तयार करण्यात येणार आहे. यासाठी ₹1722.40 कोटींचा प्रस्ताव पायाभूत सुविधा समितीच्या बैठकीत मांडण्यात आला होता. हा जोडरस्ता सागरी सेतूपासून वांद्रे किल्याजवळ जोडला जाणार असून तो 3.55 किमी लांबीचा असणार आहे. या कनेक्टरमुळे 20 ते 45 मिनिटांचा प्रवास हा 10 मिनिटांपर्यंत येणार आहे. या जोडरस्त्याचे काम महाराष्ट्र रस्ते विकास महामंडळामार्फत हाती घेण्यास या बैठकीत मान्यता देण्यात आली. नागपूर जिल्ह्यातील कन्हान परिसरातील सार्वजनिक वाहतूक मजबूत करण्यासाठी नागपूर मेट्रो रेल टप्पा-2 अंतर्गत कन्हान नदी ते कन्हान शहर या उन्नत विस्तारीत मेट्रो रेल्वे मार्गिकेस यावेळी मान्यता देण्यात आली आहे. ही मार्गिका सुमारे 1.40 कि.मी. असून त्यावर 1 उन्नत स्थानक असणार आहे. एकूण ₹310.35 कोटी इतक्या प्रकल्प पूर्णत्व किंमतीच्या या प्रकल्पाची अंमलबजावणी महाराष्ट्र मेट्रो रेल कॉर्पोरेशन लि. (महामेट्रो) मार्फत करण्यास मंत्रिमंडळ पायाभूत सुविधा समितीच्या बैठकीत मान्यता देण्यात आली. या प्रकल्पास केंद्रशासनाची मान्यता प्राप्त झाल्यानंतर या प्रकल्पाची अंमलबजावणी करण्यात येणार आहे. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, मंत्री शिवेंद्रसिंहराजे भोसले व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @mieknathshinde @SunetraA_Pawar @Shivendraraje11 #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #InfrastructureDevelopment

🤝Strengthening tax systems through collaboration and data-driven policymaking. On 17 June, the #CARICOM Secretariat co-hosted the fifth virtual workshop in the Caribbean Tax Outreach Programme alongside the OECD, the Commonwealth Association of Tax Administrators (CATA), the Inter-American Center of Tax Administrations (CIAT), IMF CARTAC and the World Bank Group. The workshop brought together 138 tax officials from 18 jurisdictions to exchange experiences on leveraging tax data to strengthen tax policy, tax administration and domestic resource mobilisation across the Caribbean. Representative of the CARICOM Secretariat Reanata Ramsey, Economic Statistician highlighted the critical role of tax data in strengthening domestic resource mobilisation, improving economic statistics and supporting evidence-based policymaking throughout the Region. Participants also explored: 📊 Key findings on tax data trends across the Caribbean and Small Island Developing States (SIDS); 🤝 National experiences from Barbados, Jamaica, Rwanda and Saint Lucia on strengthening tax data systems; 🌍 Development partner initiatives to improve tax data categorisation for global benchmarking; and 💡 Innovative approaches to using technology and tax data to build stronger, more efficient tax systems.

C’est dans cet esprit que @santearmees et l’@armeedeTerre ont uni leurs expertises à l’occasion de la formation 2026 organisée par l’ESORSEM. Cette formation incarne la force du modèle interarmées et interservices : préparer ensemble les cadres qui auront la responsabilité d’accompagner l’engagement des réservistes et de répondre aux défis de défense et de résilience nationale. He tenido por norma no hacer ningún pronunciamiento público desde la fecha en que me retiré del Ministerio de Defensa. Sin embargo, ante la muy grave información difundida en el día de hoy por la unidad investigativa de Noticias Caracol, me veo obligado a precisar: 1. La evaluación de altos oficiales de la Fuerza Pública que realicé desde aproximadamente dos semanas antes de asumir el cargo de ministro de defensa, fue un procedimiento riguroso que contó con la consulta de fuentes, documentos e investigaciones, como bien lo supo desde sus inicios el director de la unidad investigativa, Ricardo Calderón, especialmente en lo relacionado con los oficiales de la Policía Nacional y del Ejército Nacional. 2. El señor Danilo Rueda no tuvo ninguna participación ni conocimiento de ese proceso ni se le consultó jamás sobre ningún oficial, de manera que no es cierto que hubiera incidido de algún modo en la evaluación ni en la permanencia o exclusión de oficial alguno. 3. Las negociaciones o acuerdos a que hubiere llegado el señor Rueda con el Clan del Golfo o con cualquier otro grupo armado ilegal, como se escucha en las grabaciones que dio a conocer el mencionado medio de comunicación, no fueron conocidas por mí ni antes ni después de producidas y por lo tanto no tuvieron ningún efecto en las decisiones que adopté con el señor presidente de la República. 4. Las afirmaciones hechas por Danilo Rueda -de acuerdo con los referidos audios- solo lo comprometen a él y es él quien deberá dar las explicaciones correspondientes. 5. Tampoco es cierto que se hubiera convenido -ni siquiera abordado el tema- la suspensión de bombardeos. Como lo conoció la opinión pública en su momento, la prohibición de bombardeos se limitó exclusivamente a aquellos en los que se detectara la presencia de menores de edad, atendiendo al principio de precaución y a la prevalencia superior de los derechos de los niños. 6. En todo caso, como bien lo saben las cúpulas de las Fuerzas Militares y de la Policía Nacional, la autorización para realizar bombardeos la impartía exclusivamente el presidente de la República, a quien siempre se le trasladaron las solicitudes que aquellas presentaban. 7. Finalmente, es importante señalar que durante mi permanencia al frente del Ministerio de Defensa, es decir, del 7 de agosto del 2022 al 3 de marzo del 2025, se capturaron 5.063 integrantes del Clan del Golfo, se desmovilizaron 491 miembros de esa organización y 137 fueron dados de baja en desarrollo de operaciones militares. The scale of rural transformation demands something equally ambitious: every actor within the system pulling in the same direction. Over the past 3 days, the 2026 Regional Implementation Forum and Regional Farmers' Forum, hosted in #Abidjan, did exactly that. Bringing together governments, rural communities, development partners and the private sector, the forums provided a critical platform to review portfolio performance while advancing knowledge exchange and institutional partnerships as interconnected components of a unified implementation agenda. With IFAD-financed operations in West and Central Africa reaching more than 11 million people across 24 countries, the forums underscored key priorities: operational efficiency, scaling proven innovations, and strengthening coordination across governments, farmers' organizations and development actors. Throughout the Regional Farmers' Forum, representatives from regional farmers' organizations convened to discuss approaches to productive and resilient landscapes, inclusive markets and livelihoods, governance, inclusion and partnerships and operational excellence. From digital solutions and private sector engagement to youth entrepreneurship and risk-based management in fragile contexts, these priorities are central to how IFAD investments can drive rural transformation at scale. DRDO achieved a significant milestone with the successful accomplishment of Final Operational Clearance (FOC) for the Indigenous Netra Airborne Early Warning and Control (AEW&C) system, a major boost to the nation’s airborne surveillance and network-centric warfare capabilities. The ceremony was held today at CABS, DRDO, Bengaluru. Air Marshal Awadhesh Kumar Bharti, SYSM, AVSM, VM was the Chief Guest of the event. Former Chief of the Air Staff Air Chief Marshal RKS Bhadauria, PVSM, AVS,VM, ADC (Retd.) and Former Chairman of DRDO Dr. S Christopher was the Guests of Honour. During the event Dr B K Das, DG (ECS), Dr K Rajalakshmi Menon, DG (Aero), Director CABS and Chief Executive CEMILAC were also present. Over 200 officers from airforce and DRDO fraternity attended the event. Secretary DDR&D and chairman DRDO congratulated DG Aero and "TEAM AEW&C" from DRDO, IAF, Airworthiness Agencies, Academia and Indian Industry partners for achieving this milestone

Following the successful conclusion of the 89th ASEAN Committee on Science, Technology and Innovation (COSTI) Meeting on 24 June 2026 in Vientiane, Lao PDR, ASEAN convened three back-to-back Dialogue Partner meetings on STI: the 15th ASEAN–Japan Cooperation Committee on Science and Technology; the 7th ASEAN-Republic of Korea Joint STI Committee; and the 13th ASEAN–China Joint STI Committee. The meetings brought together Vice Ministers and senior officials from the 11 ASEAN Member States, Japan, China, the Republic of Korea, and the ASEAN Secretariat to align strategic priorities and strengthen cooperation in support of the ASEAN Plan of Action on Science, Technology and Innovation (APASTI) 2026–2035. The outcomes reinforced a shared commitment to building an integrated ASEAN powered by STI, advancing collaboration, global competitiveness, sustainability, and inclusive economic growth for a prosperous future.

नागपूर विमानतळ विदर्भ व मध्य भारताच्या विकासाचे इंजिन म्हणून नावारूपाला येणार मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस, केंद्रीय मंत्री किंजरापू राम मोहन नायडू व केंद्रीय मंत्री नितीन गडकरी यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत आज नागपूर येथे डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर आंतरराष्ट्रीय विमानतळ, नागपूरचे मिहान इंडिया लिमिटेडकडून जीएमआर एअरोकडे हस्तांतरण करण्यात आले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, नागपूर व परिसरात मेन्टेनन्स कमांड, ऑटो एव्हिएशन आणि डिफेन्स एव्हिएशन मॅन्युफॅक्चरिंग क्षेत्रात मोठी गुंतवणूक होत आहे. या उद्योगांसह कृषी, पर्यटन आदींच्या विकासाला गती मिळून डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर आंतरराष्ट्रीय विमानतळ, हे नागपूर, विदर्भ आणि मध्य भारतातील आर्थिक विकासाचे इंजिन म्हणून नावारूपाला येईल. देशात नवनवीन विमानतळे उभारली जात असताना नागपूर विमानतळ मोठे व सुंदर करण्याचा आम्ही संकल्प केला. 2018 मध्ये यासंदर्भात निविदा काढण्यात आल्या. 2019 मध्ये जीएमआर कंपनी पात्र ठरली होती. मात्र या संदर्भात उच्च न्यायालय व सर्वोच्च न्यायालयात याचिका दाखल झाल्या आणि अखेर सकारात्मक निर्णय आला. या प्रकल्पाचा केंद्र सरकारकडे सातत्याने पाठपुरावा करण्यात आला. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी या प्रकल्पाला पूर्ण पाठिंबा दिला व केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडळाने या प्रकल्पास मंजुरी दिली आणि आज या विमानतळाचे आधुनिकीकरण, विस्तार आणि विकासाच्या दृष्टीने जीएमआर कंपनीला हस्तांतरण करण्यात आले आहे, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. या विमानतळावर प्रवासी व कार्गो वाहतूक होण्यासाठी 2 टर्मिनल आणि 2 धावपट्ट्या होणे गरजेचे आहे. A historic milestone for ICRIER and a new chapter for Indian agriculture! Yesterday, ICRIER proudly inaugurated Rajasthan's first farmer-owned Agriphotovoltaics (Agri-PV) Plant under the PM-KUSUM scheme, a landmark achievement that demonstrates how agriculture and clean energy can work together to enhance farmers' livelihoods. Developed by the APSI Vertical at ICRIER, this pioneering initiative transforms the idea of "Solar as a Third Crop" into reality. By enabling farmers to cultivate crops while simultaneously generating solar power on the same land, the project creates a practical pathway towards higher farm incomes, greater climate resilience and sustainable rural development. This milestone reflects years of research, policy engagement and on-ground implementation led by Dr. Ashok Gulati, Head of APSI at ICRIER. The pilot was conceptualised, designed and executed by the ICRIER Agri-PV Team including, Mr. Subhodeep B., Ms. Bidisha Banerjee and Ms. Laxmi Sharma, who transformed an idea into a working demonstration for farmers across the country. We are grateful to Kotak Mahindra Bank for the CSR support that made this pilot possible, and to Mr. Chandra Shekhar Rajan (Chairman, Kotak Mahindra Bank CSR Committee and Former Chief Secretary, Govt of Rajasthan) for championing the vision of farmer-centric agri-photovoltaics. The inauguration brought together an eminent group of policymakers, administrators and sector leaders, reflecting the importance of collaborative action in scaling innovations for rural India. We were honoured by the presence and support of: 💠Dr. Shekhar Aiyar, (Director & CE, ICRIER) 💠Ms. Manju Rajpal (Principal Secretary of Agriculture, Horticulture & Panchayati Raj, Government Of Rajasthan) 💠Dr. Rohit Gupta, (Chairman & Managing Director, RRECL - Rajasthan Renewable Energy Corporation Limited) 💠Ms. Suman Chandra, IAS, Director, Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) We were also privileged to host Ms. Arti Dogra, (Chairman, JVVNL) whose visit to the pilot site a day before the inauguration and her words of encouragement greatly motivated the team as we prepared for this important milestone. Their presence reaffirmed the shared commitment of government, research institutions, financial partners and farming communities towards building climate-resilient and income-enhancing agricultural systems. As India advances its clean energy transition, this pilot offers a scalable, farmer-centric model for strengthening livelihoods. This is just the beginning, and we look forward to working with partners across the country to make "Solar as a Third Crop" a reality for millions of farmers.

India's Green Revolution was built on wheat and rice but the next productivity breakthrough may come from an unlikely crop — maize. In his latest article for the @bsindia, @Ramesh_ChandDr Ramesh Chand, Distinguished Professor, ICRIER, makes a compelling case. India's maize production has grown at a CAGR of ~9.3%, rising from 22.57 million tonnes in 2015-16 to 55.09 million tonnes in 2025-26, more than double the growth rate of rice and over three times that of wheat. What makes this more remarkable is that this growth happened without the price support ecosystem historically extended to rice and wheat. Prof. Chand argues that maize isn't just a productivity story, it's a sustainability solution. A shift from rice to maize, particularly in northwest India, could help address groundwater depletion, soil degradation, and the environmental stress associated with the rice-wheat system. The lesson for Indian agriculture? Sustainable growth will not come from increasing input use, but from unlocking productivity through technology and diversification. 🔗 business-standard.com/opinio…

About 12% of Indian women aged 25 and above hold a bachelor's degree or higher, a rate that is broadly in line with what would be expected at India's current income level. The challenge, however, is not educational attainment but labour market outcomes. Among these graduate women, roughly one in five is unemployed. Indeed, unemployment among highly educated women in India is significantly higher than in countries at comparable income levels, placing India closer to its South Asian peers than to other economies at a similar stage of development. At the same time, India performs remarkably well in one important dimension: women's participation in STEM education. Around 44% of Indian women pursuing higher education graduate in STEM fields, a share that exceeds that of many developed and developing countries alike, including the United States (38%), Canada (36%), Australia (33%), Brazil (31%), and Spain (27%). Taken together, these trends present a paradox. India has been relatively successful in expanding women's participation in higher education and, in particular, in STEM disciplines. Yet the economy appears unable to generate sufficient employment opportunities for many of these highly skilled women. This suggests that the problem is no longer one of educational access or attainment, but rather of labour market absorption. Addressing this gap will require policymakers to confront the structural barriers that prevent educated women from translating their skills and qualifications into productive employment. 【買取業務に関するご報告とお詫び】 本日、当店にて買取をご利用いただいたお客様より、「提出したカードが足りない」とのご指摘をいただきました。お客様は7枚提出されたとお申し出いただきましたが、当店側では当時5枚しか確認できず、査定担当者も「そのカードは見ていない」と回答いたしました。 その後、受付担当が防犯カメラの映像確認を提案し、査定担当者が該当の映像を確認。映っていた場面を写真で撮影し、お客様に提示いたしましたが、その映像には5枚しか映っていないように見えました。 その時点で受付担当は「映像で5枚しか確認できないため、納得いただけない場合は警察を呼んでご確認いただいた方が良いのでは」とお伝えしました。この発言はお客様への不信を前提としたものではありませんでしたが、結果として高圧的に受け取られかねないものであり、深く反省しております。 一度はお客様より「納得した」とのお言葉をいただきましたが、その数時間後「やはり足りないので再確認してほしい」とのご連絡をいただきました。PSAの鑑定番号も添えていただき、改めてより広い範囲の映像を確認したところ、お客様が査定物を出す準備の段階において、確かに7枚のカードをお出しになっていたことが確認されました。 結果として、査定担当者が7枚中5枚のみを査定し、残りの2枚を誤って査定済み用のケースに収納していたことが原因であったことが判明しました。このミスにより、お客様に不信感とご迷惑をおかけしてしまったことを、深くお詫び申し上げます。 今回の件では以下のような点が、お客様の信頼を損なう結果につながってしまいました： ①防犯映像が5枚に見えたという理由のみで、お客様のご申告を否定してしまったこと （映像には角度や映り方による限界があり、確定的な判断材料とすべきではありませんでした） ②「警察を呼びますか」といった対応が、誠実さではなく威圧と受け取られるような表現になってしまったこと ③映像確認の範囲が不十分で、カード提出の準備段階を確認していなかったこと （結果として「十分に確認もしていないのに、否定された」と感じさせてしまった可能性があります） お客様の大切なお品物をお預かりする立場として、あるまじき対応だったと真摯に受け止めております。 今後は以下のような再発防止策を徹底し、同様のことが起こらぬよう努めてまいります。 ・査定時のカード枚数を受付・査定・返却の各段階で必ず記録・照合 ・映像確認は受付〜準備段階〜査定開始までを通して行うことを明文化 このたびは、お客様に多大なご不快とご心配をおかけし、誠に申し訳ございませんでした。 今後とも誠実な対応と改善に努めてまいります。

Continuiamo a seguire una strada chiara: sostenere il lavoro, non la dipendenza dai sussidi. Creare opportunità, non assistenzialismo esasperato. On 23 June 2026, Ambassador of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka to ASEAN, H.E. Sashikala Premawardhane, presented her Letter of Credence (LOC) to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Premawardhane on her appointment as Ambassador of Sri Lanka to ASEAN and looked forward to working closely with her to further enhance ASEAN-Sri Lanka relations. He commended Sri Lanka for its active participation in ASEAN-led mechanisms, particularly the ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF), and encouraged Sri Lanka to promote its engagement with ASEAN through the frameworks of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) and the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA). He also encouraged Sri Lanka to explore opportunities for cooperation with ASEAN in areas of mutual interest, including maritime cooperation, trade, investment, tourism, business-to-business linkages, connectivity, sustainable development, education, disaster management, and people-to-people exchanges. Ambassador Premawardhane expressed Sri Lanka’s commitment to enhancing its engagement with ASEAN and the ASEAN Member States and underlined Sri Lanka’s interest in further strengthening cooperation with ASEAN. Ambassador Premawardhane also highlighted the work Sri Lanka has undertaken within the ARF framework, particularly in the areas of non-proliferation and disarmament, disaster relief, and defence education, and reiterated Sri Lanka’s keen interest in pursuing ASEAN’s Sectoral Dialogue Partnership Status. She looked forward to working closely with the ASEAN Secretariat and ASEAN Member States in identifying possible cooperation areas of mutual interest. Sri Lanka acceded to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) in 2007 and accredited its first Ambassador to ASEAN in 2016. Ambassador Premawardhane is the fourth Ambassador of Sri Lanka to ASEAN and succeeds Ambassador Admiral (Prof.) Jayanath Siri Kumara Colombage, who completed his tenure in December 2024. Video

WhatsApp का यह फीचर आपको किसी भी संभावित स्कैमर के जाल में फंसने से पहले सोचने और संभलने का मौका देगा. WABetaInfo की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, यह नया फीचर Android और iOS दोनों यूजर्स के लिए जारी किया जा रहा है. जैसे ही कोई यूजर किसी ऐसे नंबर से चैट शुरू करने की कोशिश करेगा जिससे उसने पहले कभी बात नहीं की है, स्क्रीन पर एक वॉर्निंग पॉप-अप दिखाई देगी. . . कैसे काम करेगा यह फीचर? इस वॉर्निंग विंडो में यूजर को कुछ बहुत जरूरी जानकारियां दिखाई देंगी- नंबर कहां का है, नंबर किस देश या क्षेत्र में रजिस्टर्ड है. क्या वह नंबर आपकी कॉन्टैक्ट लिस्ट में सेव है या नहीं. क्या आप दोनों किसी कॉमन वॉट्सऐप ग्रुप का हिस्सा हैं. इन जानकारियों को देखने के बाद यूजर के पास दो ऑप्शन होंगे या तो वे चैट को आगे बढ़ा सकते हैं या फिर पूरी तरह कैंसिल कर सकते हैं. खास बात यह है कि आपके फैसले की जानकारी सामने वाले यूजर को बिल्कुल नहीं मिलेगी. यह फीचर क्यों है बेहद खास? इस नए फीचर की सबसे बड़ी ताकत इसकी टाइमिंग है. अमूमन WhatsApp के सिक्योरिटी फीचर्स तब एक्टिव होते हैं जब बातचीत शुरू हो चुकी होती है. लेकिन यह नया फीचर बातचीत शुरू होने से ठीक पहले ही काम करना शुरू कर देता है. यह ठीक उसी पल स्कैमर्स का रास्ता रोकता है जब वे आपको बिना सोचे-समझे जल्दबाजी में फैसला लेने पर मजबूर करने का कोशिश शुरू करते हैं. ज्यादातर फोन स्कैम्स का तरीका बहुत सीधा होता है. अनजान नंबर से मैसेज करते हैं. शुरुआत में इस मैसेज में कुछ भी संदिग्ध नहीं लगता, इसलिए लोग अक्सर धोखा खा जाते हैं. लेकिन अब, अगर कोई दावा करता है कि वह आपका दोस्त है, और WhatsApp आपको दिखाता है कि वह नंबर किसी दूसरे देश का है, तो आप तुरंत सावधान हो जाएंगे. #WhatsApp #WhatsAppCall #SocialMedia [WhatsApp new safety feature, WhatsApp scam alert]

In a major breakthrough, Amritsar Commissionerate Police, in a joint operation with a central agency, busts a cross-border illegal arms, narcotics, and hawala network, apprehends seven accused including one Afghan national and one juvenile and recovers 10 sophisticated weapons, including two sub-machine guns, 5.048 kg of heroin, ₹30.38 lakh in hawala money. Preliminary investigation reveals that the accused were allegedly linked to foreign-based handlers operating through social media platforms. They received consignments and further distributed narcotics and illegal arms to criminal elements. The network also used hawala channels for financial transactions across various locations. An FIR has been registered at PS Islamabad, #Amritsar. Further investigation is underway to establish backward and forward linkages, identify additional associates connected with the foreign-based network, and ascertain further recoveries and arrests. @PunjabPoliceInd remains firmly committed to a zero-tolerance policy against drug trafficking, illegal arms smuggling, hawala operations and organised crime.

The objection by the representative of India to Pakistan's mention of Jammu and Kashmir in the Arria Formula meeting was not surprising to us. India, as a party to the Jammu and Kashmir dispute, has actually refused to implement the Security Council resolutions on this dispute, and has even refused to cooperate with the United Nations, including the good offices of the Secretary-General, and with all those mechanisms that form part of Chapter VI. As I stated in my statement, Kashmir is an international dispute. It is on the agenda of the Security Council. It was never a part of India, and it is not, and cannot be, part of India — because this was the core question at the heart of these Security Council resolutions on Jammu and Kashmir. The purpose was to determine the status of this territory: whether it wishes to be part of India or Pakistan. That status has not yet been determined, because the resolutions have not been implemented. To assert that Kashmir is a part of India is, in fact, itself a violation of the relevant Security Council resolutions. India’s planned $2 billion drone procurement signals a shift towards cheaper, more adaptable systems. On this day in 1975, the Emergency was imposed in India. The Emergency remains one of the darkest chapters in the history of Indian democracy. During that period, freedom of speech and expression was curtailed, attempts were made to control and undermine the judiciary, and the rights of millions of citizens were violated. The Emergency reminds us that when those in power become authoritarian, the lives of citizens, democratic institutions, and constitutional values come under serious threat. Therefore, this day is not only an occasion to remember the past, but also an opportunity to reaffirm our commitment to democracy, the Constitution, and the rights and freedoms of citizens. Our government, under the leadership of Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, remains firmly committed to upholding the Constitution in both letter and spirit and to strengthening India’s democratic institutions. The nation remains indebted to all those who stood against the injustices and excesses of the Emergency and courageously defended democracy and the Constitution.

25 जून 1975 भारतीय लोकतंत्र के इतिहास का वह काला दिन था, जब देश पर आपातकाल लगाया गया। आपातकाल के दौरान सत्ता के अहंकार में नागरिकों के मौलिक अधिकारों का हनन किया गया, प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता को कुचला गया, हजारों राजनीतिक और सामाजिक कार्यकर्ताओं, पत्रकारों तथा आम नागरिकों को अकारण जेलों में डाला गया और असहमति की आवाज़ों को दबाया गया। उस दौर में संविधान के मूल्यों और लोकतांत्रिक परंपराओं को कमजोर करने के भरसक प्रयास किए गए। प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी ने इस दिन को ‘संविधान हत्या दिवस’ के रूप में स्मरण करने का निर्णय लेकर देश को इस काले अध्याय की याद दिलाई है, ताकि भावी पीढ़ियाँ लोकतंत्र पर हुए उस प्रहार को कभी न भूलें। यह दिन लोकतंत्र, नागरिक स्वतंत्रता और संवैधानिक मूल्यों के प्रति हमारी प्रतिबद्धता को पुनः दृढ़ करने का अवसर भी है। यह हमें स्मरण कराता है कि संविधान हमारे देश का सबसे पवित्र ग्रंथ तथा हमारे लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य की सुदृढ़ आधारशिला है, जिसकी रक्षा का दायित्व हम सभी का है। आज ‘संविधान हत्या दिवस’ पर उन सभी लोकतंत्र के सेनानियों को श्रद्धापूर्वक नमन, जिन्होंने आपातकाल की तानाशाही के दौर में संघर्ष किया, यातनाएँ सहीं और लोकतंत्र की पुनर्स्थापना के लिए अपना सर्वस्व समर्पित किया। उनका साहस, त्याग और बलिदान हमें सदैव प्रेरित करता रहेगा।

Back in December 2022, the propaganda news channel Russia Today released a video promising Europe a fuel crisis and suggesting that Europeans switch to donkeys and horses because "soon the petrol will be too expensive." Four years later, they kept their promise, except that a fuel crisis broke out in Russia itself, affecting more than 50 regions. Video Anton Gerashchenko (@Gerashchenko_en) "Where the f*ck is all this heading? Why is this sh*t happening? There’s no gasoline in Moscow! How is that even possible?" The fuel crisis continues to spread across Russia. Restrictions on gasoline and diesel sales have now been officially introduced in 22 regions, meaning fuel has become difficult to obtain in roughly one out of every four federal subjects. The affected regions include Bryansk, Kursk, Belgorod, Voronezh, Ivanovo, Vladimir, Lipetsk, Volgograd, Penza, Saratov, Nizhny Novgorod, Vologda, and the Republic of Mordovia. In Siberia, limits have been imposed in the Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug - Russia's largest oil-producing region, accounting for about 40% of the country's oil output - as well as in Tyumen, Kurgan, Omsk, Novosibirsk, Kemerovo, and Irkutsk regions. Restrictions have also been introduced in North Ossetia and Adygea. Fuel sales have been suspended in occupied Crimea and Sevastopol, while in the so-called "LPR" motorists are limited to 20 liters per purchase. Regional authorities have blamed the measures on "increased demand," "logistical issues," "rising exchange-traded fuel prices," and "attempts by certain market participants to exploit the surge in demand." The Russian leadership is now pulling more air defense assets to Moscow, Valdai, and Putin’s bridge across the Kerch Strait – at the expense of air defense elsewhere. In the Moscow region alone, they have amassed hundreds of launchers for S-400, S-500, and Pantsir systems. Nearly 90 launchers have been redeployed to Valdai from other regions of Russia, and a special air defense division is also being formed there to safeguard the peace and quiet of the Russian chief. To compare, there are only a couple of launchers per direction across Russia and around their other cities. Those are their priorities. They are protecting their power – the source of this war. More than 60 Russian regions are already experiencing fuel shortages. There has also been a sharp increase in gas and diesel prices – if they are available at all. Russian security services have even proposed postponing or cancelling altogether the ritual of electing “United Russia” to the State Duma. Their latest imitation of elections was scheduled for September, and intelligence reports now show that Russia itself is not confident about what will be happening by September. The damage the war in Iran "has inflicted on Asian economies—on growth, household budgets, and government finances—is neither minor nor quickly reversible," writes expert @JoshKurlantzick. The consequential story is what the conflict "has done to Asia’s long-held assumptions about energy security—and what those shattered assumptions are going to mean going forward." "Before February 2026, Asian policymakers had understood in theory that their dependence on Persian Gulf energy was a vulnerability. The crisis transformed that abstract vulnerability into an emergency that has forced a complete regional rethink about energy security." The stakes for rapid and sustained energy diversification are high, Kurlantzick notes. The International Energy Agency's warning is blunt: if Southeast Asia fails to diversify quickly enough, its energy import bill could rise to $245 billion by 2035, tripling from $80 billion in 2024. "Whether Asian governments will deliver on these ambitions is an open question," Kurlantzick writes. "The Iran war has created a rare political window: a genuine crisis that could help overcome inertia. But windows close."

We've got our first glimpse of what a post-war Persian Gulf restart might look like...and it's not pretty. Qatar's Barzan natural gas facility suffered a deadly explosion during restart operations, killing at least 13 people. If the Gulf's best operators are struggling to bring facilities back online safely, the idea that energy exports will snap back anytime soon is a fantasy. Reopening the Strait of Hormuz is only the first step. Restarting roughly $1 trillion worth of energy infrastructure that handles explosive materials is a far bigger challenge. In the past, I've warned you about how long it takes to bring an oil field back online. In the best-case scenario, three months. In the worst-case scenario, 20 years. This is another level of danger because you're not just moving crew to moving natural gas here, you're actually doing something to it. And the chances for an explosion like we just had are very, very real. #persiangulf #qatar #commodities #geopolitics

The US/Israel war with Iran may have bumped Israel-Palestine out of the headlines. But it was, in part, a consequence of it. For years, many argued the Palestinian issue could be managed or bypassed. The region has paid the price for that assumption. I argue, in my latest article @BrookingsFP a core lesson of recent years: Middle East conflicts do not stay in their lanes. The Israel-Gaza war reverberated on the Israel-Lebanon front. The US/Israel war on Iran affects both Israelis and Palestinians. Attempts to compartmentalize these crises have repeatedly failed. Military force can degrade capabilities, eliminate threats, and create deterrence. But it cannot, by itself, resolve the political conditions that keep generating new rounds of conflict. The reality is that every time the Israeli-Palestinian conflict is pushed to the sidelines, it eventually returns, often in a more violent and regionally destabilizing form. A sustainable regional order requires equal security, freedom, dignity, and opportunity for all. It cannot exclude Palestinians—or any other people. The challenge now is bigger than securing a ceasefire or ending a war. It is breaking a cycle in which unresolved inequities fuel recurring violence—from Israel-Palestine to Iran and back again. I expand in the this article. brookings.edu/articles/the-c…

Blue Ring MTO’s maneuverability and mass-delivery capability enable a new paradigm in exploration and scouting at Mars, filling current gaps and paving the way for human exploration. Blue Ring’s bi-propellant chemical propulsion enables standard transfer windows to Mars and timely insertion into an initial Martian orbit. The highly efficient electric propulsion system augments the chemical system by increasing performance and payload capacity during interplanetary cruise and provides maneuverability at Mars, enabling access to multiple scientifically interesting orbits in a single flight. Dave Limp (@davill) By providing both propulsion for delivery and Earth communications, Blue Ring MTO dramatically simplifies requirements for orbiters and landed assets at Mars, allowing them to focus on exploration, science, and scouting rather than basic infrastructure. Next-generation high-resolution imagery, weather and dust storm monitoring, and ice mapping for fuel resources and ice science are essential for enabling human landing and advancing Mars understanding. Blue Ring MTO’s infrastructure significantly reduces the complexity, cost, and risk of these missions, enabling swarms of lower-cost, smaller missions to perform next-generation science at Mars. The confirmation of an #Ebola case in France can understandably attract attention, but the risk to the wider public remains low. Over the past 50 years, only a limited number of Ebola cases have been detected outside Africa. Well-developed and accessible health services, effective surveillance and public health measures are critical to identify, isolate and manage cases safely. বাংলাদেশ মিলিটারি একাডেমি'তে ৯০তম বিএমএ দীর্ঘমেয়াদি কোর্সের রাষ্ট্রপতি কুচকাওয়াজ, ২য় বাংলাদেশ ব্যাটালিয়ন ও নবনির্মিত প্রকল্পসমূহের উদ্বোধন অনুষ্ঠানে সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান ঢাকা, ১৮ জুন ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): বাংলাদেশ মিলিটারি একাডেমি (বিএমএ)-এর ৯০তম দীর্ঘমেয়াদি কোর্সের অফিসার ক্যাডেটদের কমিশন প্রাপ্তি উপলক্ষ্যে আয়োজিত রাষ্ট্রপতি কুচকাওয়াজ আজ চট্টগ্রামের ভাটিয়ারিস্থ বিএমএ প্যারেড গ্রাউন্ডে অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান জেনারেল ওয়াকার-উজ-জামান, এসবিপি, ওএসপি, এসজিপি, পিএসসি অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত থেকে মনোজ্ঞ কুচকাওয়াজ পরিদর্শন ও প্যারেডের অভিবাদন গ্রহণ করেন। পাশাপাশি তিনি কৃতি ক্যাডেটদের মাঝে পুরস্কার বিতরণ করেন। সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান প্রশিক্ষণ সমাপনকারী ক্যাডেটদের উদ্দেশ্যে বলেন, শপথ গ্রহণের মধ্য দিয়ে সদ্য কমিশন প্রাপ্ত অফিসারদের উপর ন্যস্ত হলো দেশের স্বাধীনতা ও সার্বভৌমত্ব রক্ষার পবিত্র দায়িত্ব। প্রধান অতিথি সেনাবাহিনীকে একটি প্রশিক্ষিত, সুশৃঙ্খল এবং আধুনিক সমরাস্ত্রে সজ্জিত পেশাদার বাহিনী হিসেবে গড়ে তোলার প্রত্যয় ব্যক্ত করেন। পরিশেষে তিনি মনোমুগ্ধকর কুচকাওয়াজ প্রদর্শনের জন্য একাডেমির কমান্ড্যান্ট, সংশ্লিষ্ট সকল অফিসার, জেসিও, এনসিও, সৈনিক এবং অসামরিক কর্মকর্তা-কর্মচারীদের আন্তরিক ধন্যবাদ জাপন করেন। দীর্ঘ তিন বছরের কঠোর সামরিক প্রশিক্ষণ শেষে এই মনোজ্ঞ কুচকাওয়াজের মাধ্যমে ৯০তম বিএমএ দীর্ঘমেয়াদি কোর্সের সর্বমোট ১৮৪ জন অফিসার ক্যাডেট বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীতে কমিশন লাভ করেন। বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীতে কমিশনপ্রাপ্ত অফিসারদের মধ্যে ১৬৬ জন পুরুষ ও ১৮ জন মহিলা অফিসার রয়েছেন। এছাড়াও, ০৪ জন ফিলিস্তিন, ০১ জন তানজানিয়া, ০১ জন জাম্বিয়া এবং ০১ জন মালদ্বীপ এর অফিসার ক্যাডেট বিএমএ হতে সামরিক প্রশিক্ষণ সম্পন্ন করেন, যারা নিজ নিজ দেশের সেনাবাহিনীতে যোগদান করবেন। ৯০তম বিএমএ দীর্ঘমেয়াদি কোর্সের ব্যাটালিয়ন সিনিয়র আন্ডার অফিসার খায়রুল ইসলাম সেরা চৌকশ ক্যাডেট হিসেবে অসামান্য গৌরবমণ্ডিত 'সোর্ড অব অনার' ও সামরিক বিষয়ে শ্রেষ্ঠত্বের জন্য 'সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান স্বর্ণপদক' অর্জন করেন। পাশাপাশি, এ একাডেমি হতে প্রশিক্ষণপ্রাপ্ত সর্বশ্রেষ্ঠ বিদেশী ক্যাডেট হিসেবে 'বিএমএ ট্রফি অব এক্সিলেন্স' অর্জন করেন সার্জেন্ট আবু বকর, তানজানিয়া। পরে প্রশিক্ষণ সমাপনকারী ক্যাডেটগণ দেশের স্বাধীনতা ও সার্বভৌমত্ব রক্ষার আনুষ্ঠানিক শপথ গ্রহণ করেন। এরপর অনুষ্ঠানে আগত অতিথিবৃন্দ এবং প্রশিক্ষণ সমাপনকারী ক্যাডেটদের পিতা-মাতা ও অভিভাবকগণ নবীন অফিসারদের র‍্যাঙ্ক-ব্যাজ পরিয়ে দেন। অনুষ্ঠানের শুরুতে প্রধান অতিথি বিএমএ প্যারেড গ্রাউন্ডে এসে পৌঁছালে ভারপ্রাপ্ত জেনারেল অফিসার কমান্ডিং (জিওসি) আর্মি ট্রেনিং অ্যান্ড ডকট্রিন কমান্ড ও কমান্ড্যান্ট, বাংলাদেশ মিলিটারি একাডেমি এবং ২৪ পদাতিক ডিভিশনের জেনারেল অফিসার কমান্ডিং (জিওসি) ও এরিয়া কমান্ডার, চট্টগ্রাম এরিয়া তাঁকে অভ্যর্থনা জানান। অনুষ্ঠানে সংসদ সদস্যগণ, দেশি-বিদেশি উচ্চপদস্থ সামরিক ও অসামরিক কর্মকর্তাবৃন্দ, সদ্য কমিশনপ্রাপ্ত অফিসারগণের পিতা-মাতা ও অভিভাবকগণ, আমন্ত্রিত অতিথিবৃন্দ এবং গণমাধ্যম ব্যক্তিবর্গ উপস্থিত থেকে এ বর্ণাঢ্য কুচকাওয়াজ প্রত্যক্ষ করেন। পরবর্তীতে, সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান বিএমএ'তে '২য় বাংলাদেশ ব্যাটালিয়ন' এর শুভ উদ্বোধন করেন। আধুনিক যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রের চ্যালেঞ্জ মোকাবিলায় বিএমএ-তে প্রশিক্ষণরত অফিসার ক্যাডেটগণের পেশাগত দক্ষতা, নেতৃত্বের যোগ্যতা অর্জন এবং প্রশিক্ষণের সার্বিক মানোন্নয়নের লক্ষ্যে '১ম বাংলাদেশ ব্যাটালিয়ন' এর পাশাপাশি '২য় বাংলাদেশ ব্যাটালিয়ন' প্রতিষ্ঠা করা হয়েছে। এছাড়াও, তিনি বিএমএ'তে নবনির্মিত সিএমএইচ, ভাটিয়ারি; বিএমএ পার্ক; বিএমএ সুইমিং পুল এবং এমইএস অফিস কমপ্লেক্স প্রকল্পসমূহের উদ্বোধন করেন। উদ্বোধনী অনুষ্ঠানে অন্যান্যদের মধ্যে উপস্থিত ছিলেন তিন বাহিনীর উর্ধ্বতন সামরিক কর্মকর্তাগণ, বিএমএ'র বিভিন্ন পদবির কর্মকর্তাগণ, অফিসার ক্যাডেটবৃন্দ এবং গণমাধ্যম ব্যক্তিবর্গ।

NITI Aayog released the eighth edition of Trade Watch Quarterly (Q4 FY 2025-26) on 23 June 2026 in New Delhi. Shri Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice-Chairman, NITI Aayog, released the Eighth edition of Trade Watch Quarterly for Q4 FY’2025-26, in the presence of other senior officials. The analysis highlights India’s resilient trade performance in Q4 FY 2025-26, supported by robust growth in services exports. While merchandise exports moderated by 2.8% to USD 112.0 billion and imports rose by 11.9% to USD 195.5 billion, services exports grew by 9.0% to USD 111.1 billion, sustaining a strong services surplus. Overall, India’s total trade reached USD 1.84 trillion during FY 2025-26, with exports growing by 4.2% and imports by 6.5%, alongside continued diversification in trade markets. This quarter’s thematic focus is on pharmaceuticals, a key pillar of India’s manufacturing and export ecosystem. With global pharmaceutical and API import demand estimated at USD 1.3 trillion in 2025 and India’s exports reaching USD 35.8 billion, the sector is well-positioned to strengthen its global footprint. The analysis highlights opportunities in biologics, biosimilars, vaccines and advanced therapeutics, alongside the need to enhance innovation, research and development, domestic API capabilities and regulatory cooperation to improve competitiveness and supply-chain resilience. कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता आणि डिजिटल नवोपक्रमांच्या माध्यमातून लोकाभिमुख, पारदर्शक आणि सक्षम प्रशासन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज विधानभवन, मुंबई येथे इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, माहिती तंत्रज्ञान आणि कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता विषयक विविध प्रकल्पांबाबत बैठक पार पडली. यावेळी महाडीबीटी 2.0 पोर्टल, सेवा केंद्र मानकीकरण, (Standardisation) डिजिटल लाइफ सर्टिफिकेट प्रणाली आणि महा AI प्रोजेक्ट अशा विविध प्रकल्पांचे लोकार्पण करण्यात आले. नागरिकांचे जीवन अधिक सुलभ करण्यासाठी राज्य सरकार सातत्याने तंत्रज्ञानाचा वापर करत आहे. राज्याच्या एआय मॉडेलद्वारे ज्ञानाधारित आणि डेटा-आधारित प्रशासन उभारण्याच्या दिशेने महाराष्ट्राने महत्त्वाचे पाऊल टाकले आहे. या नवीन उपक्रमांमुळे राज्यातील नागरिकांना शासकीय सेवा अधिक वेगाने, सुलभतेने आणि पारदर्शकपणे उपलब्ध होणार असल्याचे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, महासारथी अंतर्गत तयार करण्यात आलेला एकात्मिक डेटा पूल केवळ शासकीय योजना नागरिकांपर्यंत पोहोचवण्यासाठीच उपयुक्त ठरणार नाही, तर भविष्यातील योजना तयार करणे, त्यांचे नियोजन करणे आणि लक्ष्यित पद्धतीने अंमलबजावणी करणे यासाठीही महत्त्वपूर्ण ठरणार आहे. या प्रणालीमुळे लाभार्थ्यांचे डुप्लिकेशन टाळणे, योजनांतील गैरवापर ओळखणे आणि पात्र नागरिकांना कोणत्याही अडथळ्यांशिवाय योजनांचा लाभ मिळवून देणे शक्य होणार आहे. नागरिकांना विविध योजनांसाठी अर्ज करताना भराव्या लागणाऱ्या माहितीची संख्या कमी होत आहे. शासनाच्या डेटा पूलमधील उपलब्ध माहिती स्वयंचलितपणे अर्जामध्ये समाविष्ट होत असल्याने नागरिकांचा वेळ आणि श्रम वाचणार आहेत. भविष्यात एजंटिक एआयचा वापर वाढल्यानंतर ही प्रक्रिया आणखी सुलभ आणि वेगवान होईल, असा विश्वासही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. 'महाडीबीटी 2.0' हे राज्य शासनाचे अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे पाऊल असून महाडीबीटीच्या नव्या प्रणालीद्वारे सर्व विभागांच्या योजना एकाच व्यासपीठावर आणता येणार आहेत. यासंदर्भात सर्व विभागांनी निश्चित मुदतीत महाडीबीटी 2.0 वर स्थलांतर करावे, असे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. शिष्यवृत्ती योजनांमध्ये गैरव्यवहार टाळण्यासाठी नव्या डीबीटी प्रणालीचा फायदा होणार आहे, या योजनेद्वारे पारदर्शकता वाढली असून शासनाचे आर्थिक नुकसान मोठ्या प्रमाणात टळले आहे. सर्व योजना डीबीटीवर आल्यानंतर लाभ थेट पात्र नागरिकांपर्यंत पोहोचेल आणि भ्रष्टाचाराला आळा बसेल असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. राज्यातील आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्रे ही नागरिकांसाठी शासनाचा चेहरा असून नागरिकांना प्रत्यक्ष मदत मिळवून देणाऱ्या या केंद्रांमध्ये एकसमान सुविधा, स्पष्टता आणि गुणवत्ता असणे आवश्यक आहे. स्पर्धात्मक वातावरण निर्माण करून सेवा केंद्रांच्या गुणवत्तेत सुधारणा करण्यासाठी प्रोत्साहनपर व्यवस्था उभारण्यात येत आहे. तसेच पेन्शनधारक आणि विविध योजनांच्या लाभार्थ्यांना हयातीच्या दाखल्यासाठी आता शासकीय कार्यालयांमध्ये वारंवार जावे लागणार नाही. डिजिटल लाईफ सर्टिफिकेट प्रणालीमुळे ज्येष्ठ नागरिक आणि लाभार्थ्यांना मोठा दिलासा मिळणार असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. राज्य सरकार आणि राष्ट्रीय सूचना विज्ञान केंद्राने (एनआयसी) विकसित केलेले महा एआय मॉडेल हे महाराष्ट्राच्या डिजिटल प्रवासातील महत्त्वाचे पाऊल आहे. शासनाकडे सर्वाधिक प्रमाणात डेटा निर्माण होतो आणि वापरला जातो. डेटा हेच आजचे 'नवीन सोने' आणि 'नवीन तेल' असल्याचे नमूद करत शासनाचा डेटा शासनाच्या स्वतःच्या एआय मॉडेलद्वारे वापरणे अत्यंत आवश्यक असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. त्यामुळे स्वतःच्या डेटावर प्रशिक्षित होणारी एआय प्रणाली भविष्यातील सायबर आणि माहितीविषयक धोक्यांपासून संरक्षण देण्यास मदत करेल, असा विश्वासही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी व्यक्त केला. महा एआय मॉडेल प्रशासनातील कार्यक्षमता वाढविणे, निर्णय प्रक्रिया गतिमान करणे आणि नागरिकांना अधिक जलद सेवा देण्यासाठी उपयुक्त ठरेल. याच्या सातत्यपूर्ण वापरातून आणि प्रशिक्षणातून प्रशासन अधिक प्रतिसादक्षम, पारदर्शक आणि लोकाभिमुख होईल, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. महाराष्ट्राची डिजिटल प्रशासनात नवी झेप राज्यात सुरू करण्यात आलेले सर्व उपक्रम हे केवळ तांत्रिक सुधारणा नसून प्रशासनात लोकाभिमुखता, पारदर्शकता आणि उत्तरदायित्व वाढविण्याचे प्रभावी साधन आहेत. या सर्व उपक्रमांच्या यशस्वी अंमलबजावणीसाठी अधिकारी आणि कर्मचाऱ्यांनी त्यांचा नियमित वापर करावा, असे आवाहन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी केले. यावेळी माहिती तंत्रज्ञान विभाग, एनआयसी आणि संबंधित सर्व अधिकारी-कर्मचाऱ्यांचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी अभिनंदन केले. विविध प्रणालीबद्दल थोडक्यात माहिती महा-डीबीटी 2.0 : महा-डीबीटी 2.0 ही प्रणाली इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, माहिती तंत्रज्ञान आणि कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता विभागाने विकसित केली असून सर्व डीबीटी योजनांसाठी एकच पोर्टल आहे. सिंगल साइन-ऑन, डॅशबोर्ड व डेटा विश्लेषण सुविधा आहे. अर्जातील माहिती 138 वरून 66 क्षेत्रांपर्यंत कमी करण्यात आली आहे. आधार आधारित पडताळणी व जलद लाभ वितरणाची सुविधा देण्यात आली. आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र मानांकीकरण : आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्रामध्ये इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, माहिती तंत्रज्ञान आणि कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता विभागातंर्गत राज्यातील 31,000 हून अधिक सेवा केंद्रांचे मानांकीकरण, एकसमान ब्रँडिंग व सेवा गुणवत्ता निकष. 'स्मार्ट आपले सेवा केंद्र' दर्जा देण्याची नवीन योजना घोषित करण्यात आली. यामध्ये राज्य, विभागीय व जिल्हास्तरावर पुरस्कार देण्यात येतील. दरवर्षी 350 पेक्षा अधिक केंद्रांचा गौरव करण्यात येणार आहे. महा एआय प्रणाली : महा एआय ही प्रणाली राष्ट्रीय सूचना विज्ञान केंद्राने विकसित केली असून ती राज्य शासनाच्या विभागांमधील कामकाज अधिक कार्यक्षम, सुरक्षित आणि लोकाभिमुख करण्यासाठी ‘महा एआय’ - प्रगत कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्तेसाठी ‘महाराष्ट्र हब’ हा कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता आधारित देशातील अभिनव उपक्रम सूरू. डिजिटल हयातीचा दाखला : डिजिटल हयातीचा दाखला राष्ट्रीय सूचना विज्ञान केंद्रामार्फत सामाजिक न्याय विभागाच्या सहाय्याने ही प्रणाली कार्यरत असणार आहे. घरबसल्या हयातीचा दाखला सादर करण्याची सुविधा मिळेल. ज्येष्ठ नागरिक व दिव्यांगांसाठी सुलभ सेवा देता येणार आहे. या सुविधेमुळे कार्यालयीन भेटीची गरज नाही. कागदविरहित व रिअल-टाइम पडताळणी होणार असून लाभार्थ्यांना योजनांचा लाभ वितरणातील विलंबात घट होण्यास मदत होणार आहे. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, मंत्री ॲड. आशिष शेलार आणि वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @SunetraA_Pawar @ShelarAshish #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mahasarathi

Biz Cumhur İttifakı olarak iradeyse irade, kararlılıksa kararlılık, uzlaşıysa uzlaşı, cesaretse cesaret; üzerimize düşenleri fazlasıyla yaptık, yapıyoruz; bundan sonra da yapmaya devam edeceğiz.

Terörsüz Türkiye süreci, geride bıraktığımız 22 aylık zaman diliminde ciddi direnç testlerinden başarıyla geçti. Gelinen noktada örgütün tasfiye sürecini hızlandıracak bir yasal çerçeve üzerinde çalışıyoruz. Gerekli istişareleri yaptıktan sonra, fazla da uzatmadan söz konusu düzenlemeyi, sorunların çözüm adresi olan Meclisin takdirine sunacağız. Devletimizin niteliklerinden, milletimizin değerlerinden taviz vermeden bu meseleyi çözecek kapasiteye ziyadesiyle sahip olduğumuza inanıyorum. Cumhur İttifakı olarak Meclisimizin de desteğiyle inşallah bu hayırlı süreci tamama erdirecek, tarihe gururla anacağımız bir kayıt düşeceğiz.

İran krizi sürecinde yaşananlar, Türkiye Cumhuriyeti’nin ne kadar büyük bir devlet olduğunu herkese göstermiştir. Yine bu süreç, Türkiye’nin tecrübeli, güvenilir ve ehil kadrolar tarafından yönetildiğini bir kez daha teyit etmiştir.

In London, I joined Prof Khaled Abdel-Ghaffar, Egypt’s Minister of Health and Population, as well as our partners from @imperialcollege and @EASLnews, to agree concrete next steps to move steatotic liver disease (SLD) from World Health Assembly (WHA) recognition to practical action in countries. Next steps will include support for national SLD strategies, drawing on 🇪🇬 Egypt’s experience, a joint training programme for primary health care professionals on screening and early detection, and fellowship and research collaboration with Imperial College London. The meeting discussed a proposal to establish a tri-regional task force to strengthen coordination and support implementation across regions. We also agreed to work towards an international symposium in Egypt in November, bringing policymakers and experts from different countries and regions together to exchange experience and advance joint action on SLD. A follow-up coordination mechanism has been established and will meet within 30 days to review progress on the agreed actions. I thanked Minister Abdel-Ghaffar for his leadership in bringing SLD onto the global noncommunicable disease agenda through the WHA resolution adopted in May, and for joining us at the launch of the first-ever WHO Collaborating Centre dedicated to SLD at Imperial College London, with EASL as its clinical and scientific partner.

Today we inaugurated the first-ever WHO Collaborating Centre (CC) dedicated to steatotic liver disease – hosted by @imperialcollege, with the @EASLnews as its clinical and scientific partner. I was honoured to launch it with Prof. Khaled Abdel-Ghaffar, Egypt’s Minister of Health and Population, whose country played a leading role in the World Health Assembly (WHA) resolution on liver disease adopted in May. The need is urgent. According to the 2026 EASL– @TheLancet Commission report, cirrhosis and liver cancer cause an estimated 780 deaths every day across the @WHO European Region, around 1 every 2 minutes, and cost economies €55 billion a year. Globally, 1.5 billion people are living with steatotic liver disease. Co-directed by Prof @MarkThursz and Prof @penny_manousou, the CC will help countries assess the burden of steatotic liver disease, develop WHO-endorsed policy reports, produce prevention briefs and training tools, and turn the WHA resolution into national liver health plans.

अहमदाबाद से मुंबई जा रही तेजस एक्सप्रेस में यात्रा कर रहे एक यात्री को उस समय बड़ा झटका लगा, जब उसे अपने वेज बिरयानी बॉक्स मील में एक मरी हुई मक्खी मिली. ये घटना ट्रेन संख्या 82902 में हुई, जिसे देश की सबसे लग्जरी ट्रेनों में से एक माना जाता है. रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, यात्री ने जैसे ही अपना भोजन बॉक्स खोला, उसे बिरयानी में मरी हुई मक्खी दिखाई दी. इसके बाद उसने तुरंत रेलवे के संबंधित अधिकारियों से शिकायत दर्ज कराई है. शिकायत मिलते ही रेलवे कर्मचारियों ने तत्काल कार्रवाई की. अधिकारियों के मुताबिक, ट्रेन कैप्टन और ऑनबोर्ड कैटरिंग मैनेजर स्वयं यात्री के पास पहुंचे, घटना के लिए माफी मांगी और उसे नया भोजन देने की पेशकश की. हालांकि, इस लापरवाही से नाराज यात्री ने दूसरा भोजन लेने से इनकार कर दिया. रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, इस मामले को आईआरसीटीसी (IRCTC) ने गंभीरता से लिया और तेजस एक्सप्रेस में भोजन उपलब्ध कराने वाले कैटरिंग वेंडर के खिलाफ कड़ी कार्रवाई शुरू की. रेलवे अधिकारियों ने यात्री स्वास्थ्य और खाद्य सुरक्षा मानकों से जुड़ी गंभीर लापरवाही का हवाला देते हुए वेंडर पर 1 लाख रुपये का जुर्माना लगाया. कारण बताओ नोटिस जारी आर्थिक दंड के अलावा, अधिकारियों ने वेंडर को कारण बताओ नोटिस (शो-कॉज नोटिस) भी जारी किया है और उससे घटना पर स्पष्टीकरण मांगा है. साथ ही, रेलवे प्रशासन ने ऐसी प्रक्रिया भी शुरू कर दी है, जिसके तहत आरोप गंभीर पाए जाने पर वेंडर का लाइसेंस स्थायी रूप से रद्द किया जा सकता है. वेंडर पर कार्रवाई के बाद खाद्य सुरक्षा के लिए नए निर्देश रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, घटना के बाद रेलवे अधिकारियों ने तेजस एक्सप्रेस और अन्य ट्रेनों से जुड़े कैटरिंग स्टाफ को नए दिशा-निर्देश जारी किए हैं. वेंडरों को भोजन की गुणवत्ता की सख्त जांच सुनिश्चित करने, ताजा कच्चे माल का उपयोग करने और खाद्य भंडारण व तैयारी क्षेत्रों का नियमित /निरीक्षण करने के निर्देश दिए गए हैं, ताकि भविष्य में ऐसी घटनाओं को रोका जा सके. इस मामले ने एक बार फिर ट्रेनों में परोसे जाने वाले भोजन की गुणवत्ता को लेकर चिंताएं बढ़ा दी हैं. हाल के वर्षों में भारतीय रेलवे की ट्रेनों में यात्रा करने वाले कई यात्रियों ने भोजन में कीड़े-मकोड़े, दूषित या बासी खाना और अन्य बाहरी वस्तुएं मिलने की शिकायतें दर्ज कराई हैं. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

I’m reading an old collection of interconnected science fiction stories by Jerry Pournelle, written in the early 70s. His best books were later co-authored with Larry Niven, but it is still solid work in my favored “competence porn” genre, with entrepreneurs as protagonists. It stands out to me that he was despairing for America when he wrote the stories. Things looked bad at the time, and his fiction projected it into the future. Social unrest, Vietnam, Watergate, economic recession, energy crisis, and for a patriotic space guy, abandoning Apollo. The backdrop for the stories was that America was unfixable, which is, of course, a motivation to go to space in fiction, but I do think he was genuinely worried by what he saw around him. But over the next decade, things got better, and Jerry had a front row seat for the rise of the technology sector, writing the Chaos Manor column in Byte magazine for many years. He also got to see the founding of SpaceX, a company straight out of a hard SF novel, and they re-flew a landed rocket shortly before he died. Trends aren’t fate. Bad situations can be fixed, and good ones still need to be defended. RIP Jerry, I’m glad you got to see things turn around. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerry_…

The objection by the representative of India to Pakistan's mention of Jammu and Kashmir in the Arria Formula meeting was not surprising to us. India, as a party to the Jammu and Kashmir dispute, has actually refused to implement the Security Council resolutions on this dispute, and has even refused to cooperate with the United Nations, including the good offices of the Secretary-General, and with all those mechanisms that form part of Chapter VI. As I stated in my statement, Kashmir is an international dispute. It is on the agenda of the Security Council. It was never a part of India, and it is not, and cannot be, part of India — because this was the core question at the heart of these Security Council resolutions on Jammu and Kashmir. The purpose was to determine the status of this territory: whether it wishes to be part of India or Pakistan. That status has not yet been determined, because the resolutions have not been implemented. To assert that Kashmir is a part of India is, in fact, itself a violation of the relevant Security Council resolutions.
